settings.repere: Paragraphe · Now, if you have some questions... that'
settings.text: Now, if you have some questions... that's very common. Let me take a few moments to answer some of the most commonly asked questions about Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream.

settings.repere: Texte · "I've seen 'anti-aging' products adverti
settings.text: "I've seen 'anti-aging' products advertised... how is MiamiMD Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream different?"

settings.repere: Texte · -
Paragraphe · Before I developed this formula, I looke
settings.text: Before I developed this formula, I looked at the other products out there. And I saw huge problems with every one of them... so much so, I refused to recommend any of them to my patients. Here's why...

settings.repere: Paragraphe · First, most anti-aging products have add
settings.text: First, most anti-aging products have added fragrances or artificial ingredients. Both are terrible for your skin, and they can actually accelerate aging. Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream has no harsh chemicals or artificial ingredients whatsoever.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Second, many other anti-aging products d
settings.text: Second, many other anti-aging products don't address Progerin — and that's absolutely crucial. We talked earlier about how this protein causes aging all over your face and neck... creating serious problems, including sagging and wrinkles. So, Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream specifically targets Progerin. It also has no irritating ingredients, another "toxic skincare addition" I tell everyone to avoid.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Most importantly, though — other formula
settings.text: Most importantly, though — other formulas are designed only for temporary results. Our Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream also provides immediate benefits — but it does SO much more, too.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream utilizes p
settings.text: Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream utilizes powerful Progeline so you can build stronger, healthier skin... which means your peptides and active ingredients cannot just sit on the surface. When your anti-aging ingredients penetrate deeply... THAT'S when they can do their best work.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · So, not only does it provide visible res
settings.text: So, not only does it provide visible results…it helps maintain those improvements over time. That means YOU get to experience a dramatic transformation in firmness, a remarkable 'lifting effect,' even better skin texture, and amazing youthful radiance.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It also means any other MiamiMD formula
settings.text: It also means any other MiamiMD formula you're currently using will be enhanced as well. Because when those ingredients work together, it allows your skin to use them much more effectively.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Plus, the big difference between Age Def
settings.text: Plus, the big difference between Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream and other anti-aging formulas is that I chose the ingredients based on clinical results. Look, I'm a board-certified dermatologist with 20 plus years experience and extensive clinical research background, so I brought that expertise to the table. This formula gets real results because it's got proven ingredients at the right concentrations.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Also, Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream is n
settings.text: Also, Age Defying Lift & Firm Cream is not just an anti-aging cream at all. It's really a 4-in-1 formula that can help boost firmness, smooth wrinkles, lift sagging, and solve aging concerns like nothing else can. It's a complete package with the right stuff that works.
